verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a general web API for managing account-level resources and exporting data (sentry-docs-14/20), which could in principle be used to provision alerts/dashboards, but there is no explicit documentation of a dashboards/alerts JSON schema, Terraform provider, or dedicated 'as-code' provisioning workflow. Missing for 10: Terraform provider or module documentation, explicit dashboard/alert JSON schema or API endpoints, and any example of repeatable IaC-style provisioning.
